ConnectionStrings._comment: The real connection string, including the password, is NEVER stored here — this file goes to GitHub. Set it locally with: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:ColorsDb" "Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=colors_erp;Username=postgres;Password=YOUR_PASSWORD"  On the factory server it comes from an environment variable instead.

Jwt._comment: SigningKey is NOT here — it is a secret. Set it with: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SigningKey" "<at least 32 characters>" --project src/Colors.Api
